purpose: Integration qualification of an authenticated local research feedback loop; no new efficacy or performance hypothesis test.
production_scope: Unchanged production LedgerWriter, trust activation and append_outcome_credit_v2 code with isolated ephemeral research keys. No production credentials, external execution authority or organizational-independence claim.
acceptance: Signed Decision accepted before first observed SNN tick for each episode.
Complete signed Outcome and CreditBatch accepted before any Native Settle call.
Rejected signatures/head/expiry preserve the terminal owner and cannot start a subsequent episode.
Partial Outcome commit, signed acknowledgement loss and native acknowledgement loss recover without duplicate facts or resource credits.
Valid receipts from another episode and changed terminal or resource bindings fail closed.
All 48 authenticated facts retain independently verified Ed25519 evidence and conserved Q32 organ credit.
All observed SNN prefixes and cross-episode balances/prices match independent Python reconstruction.
Fresh original-owner replay of all 16 episodes and signed historical retries leave raw evidence byte-identical.
Protected v2 sources and exact trained checkpoint/binary remain unchanged; all new build failures, preparation, runtime and audit costs are retained.
failure_model: Deterministic signature/head faults and real fresh-process recovery with acknowledgement-loss injection. This does not simulate kernel power loss or prove service deployment authority.
